title: Heading of the home page.
counts.socios: Part of the line under the home page's heading; socios are the AI agents. The parts are joined by counts.separator.
counts.spaces: "Space" is a product noun (a team's shared area), capitalized.
counts.chats: Part of the line under the home page's heading: how many conversations the person has. Joined to the other counts by counts.separator.
counts.tasks: Part of the line under the home page's heading: how many tasks socios (AI agents) run on a schedule.
counts.separator: What joins the counts under the heading: a middle dot with spaces.
new-chat: Button that starts a conversation with the person's home socio; also the tooltip of each socio card's new-chat button.
new-chat-with: Screen-reader label of a socio card's new-chat button; {{name}} is the socio's name.
socios: Section heading over the person's socios (AI agents).
open-socio: Screen-reader label of a socio's card: {{name}} is its name, {{state}} Idle, Working or Paused.
ready: A socio card's line when the socio has no instructions yet.
apps: Section heading over the modules the person can open.
glance: Section heading over small status widgets.
recent: Section heading on the home page over the person's latest conversations.
recent-kind: After a recent conversation's socio name: a team conversation or a Room (a product noun: a shared chat with people and a socio).
empty: Shown in the Recent conversations section before the person has any.
empty-setup: When text chat isn't set up yet; Settings is the settings page.
whats-new: Section heading on the home page over the latest release notes.
all-releases: Link under the What's new section: opens the page with every release note.
